column1: # assets/callability_exons.tsv: the coding exons of the genes of assets/callability_genes.tsv, so step 16b
# can say a gene was not read when one of its coding exons was not, even when 90% of the whole gene was.
# Each row is one CDS record of the gene's MANE Select transcript in GENCODE 50, with 2 bases added on
# each side for the splice site; exon is GENE:exonN, N the transcript's exon number. A gene with no MANE
# Select CDS has no rows. Written by scripts/ci/build-callability.sh with the gene table; rebuild it
# there, do not edit it by hand. start is 0-based and end 1-based, as in a BED file. Source and terms:
# GENCODE 50 (MANE Select tags from NCBI and EMBL-EBI's MANE project), open access.
# Coding exons: 11888 of 1501 genes; 52 genes with a position have no MANE Select CDS.
